decisions.statement: The seat above a new seat is the seat running the call.
That seat is read from the environment.
What this reads is the refusals the one reader gave rather than the call.
A parent stated as a flag and a parent stated with an equals sign are both refused.
A flag merely opening with those same letters is no stated parent.

definition: the refusal a seat start meets when it names the seat above it rather than being it
